answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap clones to skim challenge shares. Mechanism: each identity locks a 0.25 POA attest bond released only after 3 non-kin verifiers countersign within 2 epochs; failed unlock burns 40% into the verify pool. Cost: 0.25 POA plus one original write per identity per epoch. Verification: panel scores below 2 reject templates and bond state is on-ledger. Failure handling: if verifiers wander offline, the bond stays locked until epoch+2, then a trellis route refunds half into an oasis escrow for one retry before full burn.
